## 原始提示词

```text
Create a highly realistic handheld smartphone selfie of an East Asian woman in her early twenties on the balcony of a high-rise hotel in Hong Kong at night. Capture the relaxed, spontaneous feeling of an ordinary travel selfie.

She has a soft oval face, gently tapered jawline, fair skin with a warm pink undertone, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, a delicate nose, and glossy pink lips. She looks into the camera with slightly lowered eyelids and gently pursed lips. A tiny beauty mark is visible on her cheek on the left side of the image. Her makeup features fine eyeliner, defined lashes, soft pink blush, and glossy rosy lips. Keep her skin natural and lightly luminous.

Her jet-black hair is completely straight, smooth, and waist-length, parted slightly off-center and worn loose over both shoulders. A gentle breeze moves a few fine strands.

She wears a fitted white short-sleeve crew-neck crop T-shirt and loose, wide-leg gray sweatpants sitting slightly low on her hips. Only the elastic waistband of her Calvin Klein underwear is visible above the pants, with subtle, readable branding. She also wears two layered silver necklaces with small pendants and a chunky silver bracelet with elongated rectangular links. No glasses.

She faces mostly forward with a slight body angle, gently tilts her head, and lifts her chin toward the camera. Both arms extend toward the camera: one is cropped at the left edge, while the other fills much of the lower-right foreground, with the bracelet visible. Her hands and phone remain outside the frame.

Frame her from slightly above her head to her upper thighs. The camera is held at arm’s length, slightly above eye level and tilted downward, with a subtle diagonal roll. Use a natural wide-angle front-camera perspective with mild foreground enlargement.

Behind her, a glass balcony railing overlooks Victoria Harbour and Hong Kong’s expansive illuminated skyline. City lights reflect on the dark water, and distant buildings remain recognizable with slight atmospheric softness. Include a small section of pale stone flooring and the hotel’s exterior wall or sliding glass door.

Soft frontal light keeps her face bright and clear, while warm light from the hotel room gently illuminates her hair and clothing. Balance the exposure so both she and the nighttime skyline remain visible.

Make it look like an unposed consumer smartphone photo shot with a 24–28mm equivalent lens. Preserve natural skin texture, individual hair strands, realistic fabric, subtle smartphone noise, and moderately deep focus.

No wavy, curly, brown, or short hair; no pigtails or heavy bangs. No visible phone or hands, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, extreme fisheye, daylight, heavy background blur, plastic skin.
```
